Fans of the first two films have reason to breathe a sigh of relief: the core of the Abbott family remains intact. Emily Blunt returns to her role as mother Evelyn, joined by her on-screen children Millicent Simmonds and Noah Jupe. Oscar winner Cillian Murphy is also on board: he's reprising his role from Part 2.
